notes.title: Level 3 Update on Demo
notes.notes:
[p][b]Banana Loco Level 3 is Here![/b][/p][p]Attention, Banana Hunters! 🍌🚀 The wait is over—[b]Level 3 has arrived in the Demo![/b] Get ready for new challenges, more fun, and exciting surprises![/p][p]🔹 [b]What’s new?[/b]
✨ Access to [b]Level 3[/b] – Brace yourself for crazier, wilder adventures!
✨ [b]New cards unlocked[/b] – Play with the [b]Yellow Map[/b] and [b]Green Map[/b] cards for fresh strategies![/p][p]Are you ready to take Banana Loco to the next level? Update now and start playing![/p]

notes.title: Banana Loco Demo is Out!
notes.notes:
BANANA LOCO Demo is now released on Steam! 🍌🔥

Get ready to go bananas for adventure! 🍌💛 We're thrilled to announce that Banana Loco Demo—the ultimate treasure-hunting game—is out on Steam!
